== Summary ==
Cover banner of [[Mercenaries (Virtual Block 6)|Mercenaries]], release 6.3 of [[Virtual Block 6]], from page 1 of its release PDF. The cover reads "Official text as of March 15, 2010". The file was created on 4 April 2010.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf VirtualBlock6_3.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 150 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover images, and cropped to the banner (976&times;601 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174429/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf Internet Archive].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-1/10/Set-VB6.3-logo.jpg Internet Archive item].
